layout.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).

components.buttons: Rounded-xl or pill-shaped. Deep Forest Green bg, White text. Use hover:-translate-y-[1px] and hover:shadow-md.
components.cards: Flat background. 1px solid border (#E2E8E4). No shadow. Rounded-2xl.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults customized with #E2E8E4 border and #1B4D3E focus ring. Use rounded-xl.
components.tables: Flat, cardless. Rows should have subtle bottom borders. Header text should be the 'label' typography.
components.stepper: Custom numeric input for kg quantities. Pill-shaped, earthy background.

motion.list_stagger: Use Framer Motion to stagger entry of vegetable list items.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building for a React js (.js) environment, NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Generate plain JS files.
Enforce the Organic & Earthy archetype. The platform is for fresh vegetable supply.
For the restaurant view, focus on a mobile-first list where users can quickly tap '+' and '-' to order vegetables in kg. Use 'surface_glass' for a sticky bottom bar showing the live total bill.
For the admin view, implement a crisp dashboard grid with flat cards. Avoid unnecessary shadows.
ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Use Shadcn components heavily but strip the Vercel aesthetics to match the earthy colors.
Never use pure black or white where an earthy off-white (#FAFAF8) or charcoal (#1C1C1C) applies.
